name: Forgiveness

definition_by_age.4: Saying it's okay after someone says sorry.
definition_by_age.6: Forgiveness means letting go of upset feelings when someone makes a mistake and says sorry.
definition_by_age.8: Forgiveness is choosing to release anger and give someone another chance, the way Allah forgives us.

learning_objective: Children can describe forgiving a friend after a small mistake.

recommended_default.note: Reassigned 2026-08-05 during pattern-diversity fix (was pattern_002). Misunderstanding->Conversation->Reconciliation is the two-party pattern built for forgiveness — was on generic pattern_002.

qv_008.reasoning: Explicit command to pardon and overlook, directly on-topic for forgiveness.

alternative_patterns.reasoning: A sibling breaking something fits responsibility/trust-rebuild as well as reconciliation.
